title: Choosing by track: what somebody hiring in your field actually opens

videos.script: Somebody hiring a front-end developer opens a link and tries the page on their phone. Somebody hiring a data engineer opens the pipeline and looks for what happens when it runs twice. Neither of them reads the other's portfolio the same way. {{two}} So the project you build depends on your field, and the question is not what is impressive in general. It is what the person who would give you your first task opens first. {{question}} Here is the answer for your track, a way to check it against real job adverts, and three filters for choosing. It ends with the choice this course made, and the ideas it turned down.
